screen.scoobycaster.config.title: ScoobyCaster Config
config.scoobycaster.option.left-interval: Set the amount of milliseconds to wait after a left click.
config.scoobycaster.option.right-interva: Set the amount of milliseconds to wait after a right click.
config.scoobycaster.option.last-interval: Delay after the last click of a spell before the next spell can start. Old configs load this as 0 (no delay): set it here or delete config/scoobycaster.json.
config.scoobycaster.option.repeat-melee-: Repeat melee hits if the melee button stays pressed.
